CN201503 [coercive]: 2015, July-Nov: three coercive actions against Vietnamese ships around Spratly Islands (Tuoi Tre, “Chinese warship soldiers point guns.”)
CN201504 [demonstrative]: 2015: PRC's Spratly island building intensifies further (AMTI, "Island Tracker").
